# Side Stash

> Side Stash is a Chrome browser extension for collecting text, links and image URLs in a private side panel. Developed by LanrenwenStudio.

## Product facts

- Save selected text, links or images using the right-click menu. Alt+S saves selected text.
- Search and filter by type, date or source site. Pin items and select multiple items to copy, cut or delete.
- Copy as plain text, Markdown or with source context.
- Export JSON for backup and import, or export Markdown. Download selected images individually or as ZIP.
- Saved items and preferences use local Chrome extension storage. No account or cloud synchronization is provided.
- The website playground uses demonstration data and is not the user's extension collection.
- Export a backup before clearing browser data or uninstalling the extension.
